text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text: âAh, today's the Shuka Sho, huh. ...

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
What do you want to do? Should we still go 
now? To be honest, I'm fine either way, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Nah, actually, I've had enough of 
races "for now"! More importantly, did you 
see Curren-chan's Umasta post?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! Yukino-chan was on screen, 
wasn't she?! Her peace sign was so 
terribly awkward... honestly... it made me 
wonder if she's literally an actual baby—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Alright.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally time, isn't it? The Shuka 
Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna give it everything I've got 
today too, and put on a sparkling run!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I do that... surely the people who were 
disappointed and thought I wasn't the real 
deal will cheer for me again—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Huh, the usual crowd isn't here today. 
Yukino Bijin's fans really stand out, 
after all.”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Does it feel like we're 
finally getting back to the usual yearly 
vibe?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why, though. Yukino was amazing 
in the Oaks, after all.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Well, who cares! We're Harp Alpha fans, 
after all. I really hope she wins this 
time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Then... who am I even supposed to run 
for...?

A different racing atmosphere than before. 
It was a subtle change, but quite enough 
to make Yukino Bijin feel bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... What in the world should I 
do...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I win, if the people I want 
watching aren't there..."
choice_data_list: There are so many people rooting for you.
There are so many people cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know that, but... I thought maybe, just 
maybe, I could change something today, and 
so—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? I wonder what that "something" was...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, my brain's gotten all tangled 
up...!

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin-san! Please get ready soon!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I gotta go...!
choice_data_list: Yukino, just forget about everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list:
Show them what all your hard work has 
built!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah! I just gotta do it...!
